actual_scope: One hosting implication for the selected PR589 bit supplier: do the window-free partial width-seven rows of merged #1023 and merged #1281 (width-7 residuals placed in capacity-7 idle slots without time order) survive PR442's replica-local hosting windows (audit_hosted_k: s in W[i] for every hosted slot) on the nine-stage template? Exact window-respecting optimum and certificate for every k = 0..74.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one exact hosting implication; this narrows it to the time-order hypothesis that #1023 lists as unchecked and that #1281 states as its open question 1. Replica-local hosting only; cross-replica owner maps, projector compatibility, owner inactivity and a physical width-7 helper stay open.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the bit supplier; the selected record is complex-bound, so no kappa changes. It corrects the bit headroom any partial width-seven helper mechanism can buy under replica-local hosting: about two thirds of the window-free gain, so the published rows overstate it by about 1.5x.
stop_rule: Stop once every k = 0..74 has an explicit window-feasible placement and a tight grid certificate under both local brackets, k = 0 reproduces the selected bit endpoint, and every #1023 and #1281 row is compared; report any row not decided instead of claiming it.
evidence: RESULT.json: windows equal in three implementations (own, PR442 hosting_core, audit_hosted_k), frozen selection inside them; capacity-7 children 1/3/5 admit only stages 2/4/6, so at most 3k of 9k width-7 residuals per replica sit in 7-slots. Exact window-respecting optimum with explicit placement and tight 1e-24 certificate for every k = 0..74, both brackets; k = 0 reproduces 0.001733427039589844234749. k = 37 optimistic 0.001770809187 (+2.157%) vs window-free 0.001789671631 (+3.245%); k = 74 0.001809907119 (+4.412%) vs 0.001849754238 (+6.711%). Retained fraction 0.636-0.671 (optimistic), 0.563-0.607 (pessimistic). All 8 #1023 partial rows and all 148 #1281 local rows unreachable; #1281's 75 idle optima and 9 priced cases reproduced exactly from its merged EXPECTED.json; its pooled32 rows above the per-replica bound. #1023's all-width-7 optimum stays window-feasible (104 sextet splits). 11 tests pass.
